scripts.start: npm run build:lib && node scripts/build-libs.mjs && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs && ng serve
scripts.build:lib: npm run build:lit && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based-basics && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based-math && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based-complex && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based-graphs && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based-network && ng build @scaljeri/flow-based-data
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:lib && node scripts/build-libs.mjs && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs && ng build flow-based-demo && node scripts/build-playground.mjs
scripts.test: ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-core && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-math && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-complex && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-graphs && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-data && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-network && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based && ng test @scaljeri/flow-based-basics && ng test flow-based-demo
scripts.serve:lit-demo: npm run build:lit-demo && node scripts/serve-static.mjs dist/lit-demo 4400
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build:lib && node scripts/build-libs.mjs && node scripts/build-lit-demo.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build:lib && node scripts/build-libs.mjs && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs && ng build flow-based-demo --base-href /fbp/ && node scripts/build-playground.mjs && node scripts/deploy.mjs dist/demo/browser fbp
